slides.headline: Learn a new business skill with an AI tutor.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: You get a wall of text and forget it by tomorrow.

slides.label: Prompt 1
slides.title: Set the goal
slides.card: I'm a beginner at [skill]. Make a 7-day plan, 20 minutes a day, for my business.

slides.label: Prompt 2
slides.title: Explain it simply
slides.card: Explain [topic] in plain English. Use an example from a small business like mine.

slides.label: Prompt 3
slides.title: Quiz me
slides.card: Ask me 5 questions, one at a time. Tell me what I got wrong before the next one.

slides.label: Prompt 4
slides.title: Try a real task
slides.card: Give me a small real task to try. Then review my attempt and show me what to fix.

slides.label: Prompt 5
slides.title: Check the facts
slides.card: What in your answers should I verify with an official source or an expert?
slides.note: For legal, tax or money: ask a professional.

slides.headline: Save this for your next skill.
slides.sub: Try spreadsheets, ads or pricing basics.

scenes.headline: Get your process out of your head.
scenes.sub: Make it an SOP with AI.

scenes.label: THE PROBLEM
scenes.wrong: It only lives in your head.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here is how I do [task]: [paste your steps]. Turn it into an SOP: purpose, numbered steps, tools, common mistakes, 5-item checklist. Ask me what's missing first.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Test it once. Fix the gaps.

scenes.note: Remove client names before you paste.
